batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan of the JU D3-Unit (Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Faculty of Biological Sciences) 2013-2014 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2013-2014-set4.pdf (4 pp.). ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED DISCREPANCIES: (1) the Drive listing calls this file 'Set-4', but the printed header box on p.1 reads 'Set CODE: 1'; (2) the listing files it as a plain D-Unit paper, but the printed header reads 'D3-ইউনিট, প্রাণরসায়ন ও অণুপ্রাণ বিজ্ঞান বিভাগ, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ' — a department paper of the Biology Faculty, not the common D-Unit paper. The printed header governs: paper id ju-d3-2013-2014-set1. Printed header: session ২০১৩-২০১৪, 45 minutes, full marks 60; the paper prints exactly 60 questions. The compilation prints each question followed by a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key (X = Bangla letter ক/খ/গ/ঘ, mapped to options a-d in printed order); short ব্যাখ্যা boxes are printed for some questions (mainly Chemistry, Q26 onward); ব্যাখ্যা text is never part of a question's text. The compilation prints NO subject section headings; subjects were assigned per question by content: Biology Q1-25 and Q44 (Botany/Zoology split in topic, by content), Chemistry Q26-43 and Q45, Bangla Q46-53, English Q54-60. All 60 questions are keyed; 0 keyless, 0 dual, 0 printed dispositions. Two printed keys are apparent errors (Q1, Q7) and one key box contradicts its own ব্যাখ্যা (Q40); all preserved as printed and flagged. Transcribed visually from 300 dpi page renders (page image authoritative; OCR used only as a finding aid); every key glyph was additionally audited on enlarged key-box strips, with খ/গ disambiguation at 3x zoom against intra-paper reference boxes where the watermark crosses a box. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D3 Unit (Biochemistry and Molecular Biology dept) 2013-2014 question paper, printed Set CODE 1 (Drive listing 'Set-4') — compiler-solved scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive PDF)
sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key after each question; keys use Bangla letters ক-ঘ; short ব্যাখ্যা boxes for some questions). Aggregator footers 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com' and a diagonal watermark are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; the watermark crosses a few key boxes (read at zoom; see ANSWERS.md). Handwritten/reader marks were not treated as keys. Two-column layout. Downloaded from the AdmissionWar Google Drive archive for the admission-research project. The Drive listing label 'Set-4' and its plain-D filing disagree with the printed header (D3-ইউনিট, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology dept; 'Set CODE: 1'); the printed header governs the paper id.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪; D3-ইউনিট, প্রাণরসায়ন ও অণুপ্রাণ বিজ্ঞান বিভাগ, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, সাভার; boxed set label 'Set CODE: 1'; সময়: ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য (printed under the header): প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না। পরীক্ষার শুরুতেই OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে নিচের বাক্য দুটি হুবহু লিখতে হবে — (ক) প্রাণরসায়ন ও অণুপ্রাণ বিজ্ঞান একবিংশ শতাব্দীর বিজ্ঞান (খ) Biochemistry and Molecular Biology is the Science of 21st Century.
